Secret cults are hidden all over Tibia. The druid {npc:Gerimor}, in Feyrist, asks you to investigate seven cults (Barkless, Misguided, Patron of the Arts, Orc Idol, Sandy Cave, Minotaurs and Zathroth Remnants) and defeat their bosses. After all of them, you face {creature:The Source of Corruption} and receive 325,000 experience in total, the crown of your vocation, a {item:Mystery Box} and the achievement **Corruption Contained**.
Secret cults are hidden all over Tibia.
Minimum level 8 (150+ recommended; the bosses are for teams of up to 5 players, the final one up to 10).
Access to {wiki:Feyrist|Feyrist} (see {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest|Threatened Dreams Quest}).
Defeat all the cult bosses at least once before the final mission.
20,000 gp (10,000 to become a patron of the museum and 10,000 to pay Iwar)
for Zathroth Remnants (Humans); it is in a chest in Carlin
for the fight against The Sandking (Life)
to come back from the Edron Orc Cave (Orcs): you have to dig the entrance
One small gem ({item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}) for each trip to Feyrist
325,000 experience in total (50,000 or 25,000 per cult + 50,000 at the end)
Cult bosses (Ravenous Hunger, The Souldespoiler, The Unarmored Voidborn, The Sandking, The False God, Essence of Malice)
After passing the trials of each cult and gaining access to the boss lever room.
Repeatable every 20 hours, teams of up to 5 players; you return directly to the lever room.
After defeating all the cult bosses (final mission, in Feyrist).
Start by talking to {npc:Gerimor} in Feyrist and ask about all the cults: that way they are all open in the Quest Log and it is easier to follow your progress.
You can do the cults (access and boss) in any order you like. Only the final mission requires you to have defeated all the bosses.
Each cult boss can be fought by teams of up to 5 players, every 20 hours. After you gain access, you just need to go back to the lever room to kill it again.
The final boss ({creature:The Source of Corruption}) takes up to 10 players, also every 20 hours.
After each boss, go back to {npc:Gerimor} to hand in the cult and receive the experience.

With the fae seal from the {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest|Threatened Dreams Quest}, get a {item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}. Each city has a corridor with four arches (ice, earth, fire and energy) that lead to the {wiki:Holy Shrine|Holy Shrines}: enter the arch of your gem's element and **use** the gem on the shrine inside (the gem is used up). You arrive at {wiki:Feyrist|Feyrist}; {npc:Gerimor} is in the village, in the centre of the peninsula.

Go to **Feyrist** and talk to {npc:Gerimor}. Say {key:hi} and then {key:missions}. He lists the seven cults: ask about each one ({key:Life}, {key:Prosperity}, {key:Minotaurs}, {key:Barkless}, {key:Misguided}, {key:Orcs}, {key:Humans}) to open them all in the Quest Log.
To hand in each cult later, say {key:hi}, {key:missions} and the name of the cult (for example {key:Minotaurs}).

To return to the mainland (and go to the cults' hideouts), **use** any of the four shrines in Feyrist and you are teleported back. To leave you **do not need a gem**; only to get back in. Repeat the step “Get to Feyrist” whenever you have to hand in a cult to Gerimor.

The cult is in the troll cave of Ab'Dendriel. You have to pass two trials (tar and sulphur), a purification and absorb 10 symbols before you reach the boss. Watch out for the {creature:Barkless Devotee|Barkless Devotees} and {creature:Barkless Fanatic|Barkless Fanatics}: they are much stronger than normal elves and their Poison Ball does a lot of damage, even with a blocker.
Enter the troll cave of **Ab'Dendriel**. Go down again and then go up through the rope spot to the **south**. Bring a {item:Rope} for the rope spot.
Walk **northeast** until you reach the {item:Mystic Flame}.
Walk **west** and you find {npc:Tigo}. If you have not talked to him yet, say {key:hi} and ask for a {key:mission}: without this you cannot get into the building.
Enter the building **west** of Tigo and leave through the door to the **north**. Follow the path and go up the hole at the end. From here you are in the Barkless area.
Map of the Barkless trials area
This area is full of {creature:Barkless Devotee|Barkless Devotees} and {creature:Barkless Fanatic|Barkless Fanatics}.

Walk **northeast** to the {item:Tar|tar} area. Fight your way to the end of this area, to a special tar tile, but **do not step on it yet**. While you walk through the tar pits you will see these messages: *“As you enter the tar pits, you feel the heal around you rising dramatically...”*, then *“Your body is heating up, the air around you is flickering.”* (two or more times) and finally *“The heat is now unbearable, the blood in your body feels like lava. There's almost no strength left in you - act quickly!”*.
First tar tile (do not step on it before the last message)
Tar trial: step on the tile

As soon as you see the last message (*“The heat is now unbearable...”*), step on the tar tile. You should receive: *“Embrace the stigma of bad fortune. The tar does not feel so hot anymore. You passed the tar trial.”*
Tar trial: run to the second tile

Now **run** to the other tar tile, behind a sealed door. If you step on it in time you see: *“You are now ready to prove your worth. Take heart and cross the threshold of tar.”* The tar trial is complete.
Second tar tile (behind the sealed door)
If you take too long, the tar cools down (*“The tar covering you has cooled down and fell off for the most part...”*) and you have to go back to the tar area and start again.
Kill the creatures on the path between the two tiles beforehand so the run is safer.

This trial works like the tar one. Go to the {item:Sulphur|sulphur} tile where you can walk, but **do not step on it** until you receive the four messages: *“As you enter the sulphur pits...”*, *“The sulphur is burning your skin...”* (two or more times) and *“The acid burning is now unbearable, your skin feels like a sieve. There's almost no strength left in you - act quickly!”*.

After the last message, step on the tile (*“Embrace the sigma of vanity. The sulphur does not burn your skin anymore. You passed the trial.”*). Then **run** to the second tile. If you arrive in time you see: *“You are now ready to prove your worth. Take heart and cross the threshold of sulphur.”*
Once again, clear the creatures from the path before you run.
Purification: cool down in the water

After the two trials you have to purify yourself. Go to the cold area, next to the water. You have to go through the **middle** of the spawn, because you cannot open the doors to the west and east yet. Wait for the four messages: *“As you enter the icy cavern...”*, *“Your body temperature sinks...”* (two or more times) and *“The icy cold is grasping to you. You can barely move anymore.”*
Step on the small bridge to wash yourself. You receive: *“You are now washed and ready to purify yourself in the chamber of purification.”*

Go to the purification chamber to the **southwest** and pass through the energy gate. Your character **dies**, but do not worry: you do not lose experience, skills, items or blessings. Because you die, you respawn in the temple of your home town: go back to Ab'Dendriel and enter the troll cave again by the same route.
Do not worry! You are going to die, but you lose nothing.

Go back to the cult area in Ab'Dendriel. You have to absorb the power of 10 {item:Cult Symbol|Cult Symbols} of the Barkless hanging on the walls. Use the first one, right next to the {item:Mystic Flame}, and the second one, inside the building next to {npc:Tigo}.
There are three more symbols in the trials area.
West door (open once from the north)
East door (open once from the north)
To be able to open the doors at {coord:32686,31431,8} and {coord:32754,31443,8}, you have to reach them through the central passage and open them once from the **north** side.
Symbols 6 to 10 (to the west, past the sealed door)
The last 5 symbols are west of the trials area, past the sealed door (which you can now open), on the floor below.

Go to the big room in this area and use the {item:Cult Object} in the centre of the room. You receive *“As you reach out to touch the cult object, a surge of energy bursts from the skull. You banished its power.”* and you gain access to the boss room.
Click the object to complete the access.

In the boss room you find {creature:Leiden} in the centre (with about half health) and the {creature:Wine Cask (Creature)|Wine Cask} to the north. **You cannot hurt Leiden directly** (if you attack him he heals). Attack the Wine Cask: it summons {creature:Liquor Spirit|Liquor Spirits}. Keep the Liquor Spirit close to Leiden and attack **only the Spirit**: each time it is hit it casts area spells that hurt Leiden. The Spirit evaporates a few seconds later, so attack the Wine Cask again to summon more.
Leiden and the two {creature:Barkless Fanatic|Barkless Fanatics} he summons hit very hard. Use a {item:Dwarven Ring}: there are area spells that cause drunkenness.

Alternative: "heal" Leiden with {spell:Mass Healing} and {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes}. On him healing does damage, so you can ignore the Wine Cask and the Spirits. You can also place {item:Fire Bomb|Fire Bombs} on the floor and make the Liquor Spirit walk over them for extra hits.

When Leiden dies, the {creature:Ravenous Hunger} appears. Now the Liquor Spirits **heal** the boss, so stay away from the Wine Cask. Kill it like a normal strong creature (it is immune to death damage). Use {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb Runes} to keep the summoned {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} away and reduce the damage on the blocker.
After the boss, leave the room and go back the same way to the troll cave entrance: go down the rope spot hole you came up through and climb the stairs to the surface of Ab'Dendriel.
Go back to Feyrist and talk to {npc:Gerimor}: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Barkless}. To get there, use a shrine (step “Get to Feyrist”).
You have to perform 5 exorcisms with a charged Rubbish Amulet before you can face the boss.

Go to the **Outlaw Camp** and go down the stairs. Walk **east** and step into the {item:Water Vortex} (you do not need diving equipment). The {wiki:Outlaw Camp} is **east of Thais** and **west of Venore**: leave Thais through the east gate (or Venore through the west gate) and follow the road to the camp.
Walk **south** to {npc:Noozer}. Say {key:hi} and, when he asks if you just want to pass, answer {key:yes}.

Go down the hole to the **south** and then go up again to reach the area of the {creature:Misguided Thief|Misguided Thieves} and {creature:Misguided Bully|Misguided Bullies}. Kill them until one drops a {item:Rubbish Amulet} (semi-rare drop, it may take a while).

Equip the amulet. You see *“The amulet burns your skin. It hungers for energy right now, gather a large amount of energy as fast as possible to charge it.”* Kill **10 Misguided creatures** quickly to charge it. It turns into a {item:Glowing Rubbish Amulet}.

If you take too long to charge it, the amulet falls off your neck and loses all its charges (*“The amulet fell off. You took too long to recharge it...”*). Pay attention so you do not lose it on the floor.
Use the amulet on a living Misguided

You have **5 minutes** to use the {item:Glowing Rubbish Amulet} on a living Misguided. It becomes paralysed ({creature:Paralysed Bully} or {creature:Paralysed Thief}) and its true form appears, a {creature:Misguided Shadow}. If you are in the buildings area, the map changes and the gold on the floor disappears.

Kill the {creature:Misguided Shadow} to complete an exorcism. The amulet loses its charges (*“The amulet you are wearing suddenly feels quite cool and emits a strange light.”*) and goes back to being a normal {item:Rubbish Amulet}.
The exorcism point goes to whoever does the most damage to the Shadow. In a party with shared experience, everyone who did damage gets the point.
Repeat the process (charge with 10 kills, use the amulet, kill the Shadow) **4 more times**, until you have **5 exorcisms**.
With the 5 exorcisms you can cross the energy barrier at the end of the Misguided cave and enter the boss lever room.

In the room are {creature:The Sinister Hermit (Yellow)|The Sinister Hermit} (invulnerable) and several {creature:Inactive Geyser|Inactive Geysers}. There is always one active geyser (the message *SPLASH* appears on screen). Lure the Hermit onto the active geyser: he turns into {creature:The Sinister Hermit (Blue)} and becomes vulnerable. Attack him while the geyser is active (10–15 seconds) and then move on to the next active geyser.
The Hermit is only vulnerable on top of the geyser and moves a lot: use other players to block his path.
Each time the Hermit changes form, two {creature:Vermin Swarm|Vermin Swarms} appear. Kill them so you do not get surrounded.

When the Hermit dies, {creature:The Souldespoiler} appears. At first he is almost invulnerable, but over time {creature:Freed Soul|Freed Souls} appear and weaken him. Keep attacking: once three Freed Souls have appeared he becomes very weak and easy to kill.

The wiki does not describe the exit from the Misguided Camp. After the boss, go back the same way to the area where you arrived through the {item:Water Vortex}, near {npc:Noozer}, and return from there to the Outlaw Camp, on the surface.
Go back to {npc:Gerimor} and hand in the cult: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Misguided}. To get there, use a shrine (step “Get to Feyrist”).
This mission has no boss: it is an investigation in the Museum of Tibian Arts that ends in a number puzzle. You need 20,000 gp.
Become a patron of the museum

In **Thais**, west of the Knights Guild, step into the teleport to the {wiki:Museum of Tibian Arts|Museum of Tibian Arts}. Talk to {npc:Gareth}: say {key:hi}, {key:patron} and confirm with {key:yes} to pay **10,000 gp**. The teleport is beneath the Thais Games Hall, 1 floor down, and only works with a Premium account. To leave the museum, go back the same way to the entrance teleport.
Ask Gareth for a {key:mission}. Then go **southwest**, pass the {item:Sealed Door} and enter the room with the {item:Hyaena Statue|Hyaena Statues}. Read the {item:Ransom Note} on the floor.
Go back to {npc:Gareth} and say {key:mission}. He sends you to {npc:Iwar}, in Kazordoon.
Go to **Kazordoon** and talk to {npc:Iwar}. Say the code phrase {key:has the cat got your tongue}. He offers you the painting back for **10,000 gp**: confirm with {key:yes}.
Go back to {npc:Gareth} and talk about your {key:mission}. He sends you to {npc:Angelo}, beneath the Dark Pyramid, to fetch a magnifying glass.

Go to the bottom floor of the **Dark Pyramid** (Darashia) and enter the room to the **southwest**, where there is a {item:Hole (Pitfall)|hole}. Follow the path **north** to {npc:Angelo}. Ask him about a {key:magnifier}: he lets you take one from the crate. Use the {item:Angelo's Crate} to get a {item:Loupe} (*“Perfect! You took a wonderful loupe from the crate.”*). The Dark Pyramid is **northeast** of Darashia. To leave, go back the same way to the hole and climb up through the pyramid to the surface.
Hole at the bottom of the pyramid
If you have already killed {creature:The Sandking}, Angelo refuses to talk to you: use the crate straight away.

Back at the museum, go to the paintings directly **west** of Gareth. Use the Loupe on the corner of the pillar with the paintings: you find the fake painting (*“This is it. It looks like it was painted by a child!”*). Talk to Gareth about the {key:mission}: he asks you to fetch a new artefact from Angelo.

Ask {npc:Angelo} about a {key:new artifact}. He does not trust you. Go back to {npc:Gareth} and report the failure with {key:mission}: he gives you access to the lowest floor of the museum (just west of the Ransom Note room).
In the **west** part of the museum's floor -2 is the NPC {npc:Denominator}, behind two {item:Sealed Door|Sealed Doors}. Use the **north** one.
Use the lever and read your number

Go down the stairs and go to the far **east**, where there is a {item:Lever|lever}. Use it to move the three {item:Stone Block|Stone Blocks} to the east. Each stone represents a digit, equal to the number of squares it moved, read from left to right starting at **0**. Example (X = stone): `012X45`, `0X2345`, `01X345` → digits **3**, **1** and **2** (number 312). Memorise your three digits.
The position of the stones is different for each player, and only one player at a time can do this part.

Go back to {npc:Denominator}, say {key:hi}, then {key:questions} and {key:yes}. You have to answer **5 questions in a row without a mistake**. The questions vary. These are the known ones, with the answer for the example 3-1-2:
Only if it ends in 0 or 5
The number without spaces or symbols
If you get an answer wrong you have to start over. If you take too long, the lever resets and you have to fetch a new number.
With all the answers right, the mission ends (there is no boss). Go back to {npc:Gerimor}: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Prosperity}. To get there, use a shrine (step “Reach Feyrist”).
To get past the three barriers you have to be transformed into a specific type of orc. The one who transforms you is the {creature:Orc Cult Priest}, so don't kill them all.

Go to the {wiki:Edron Flats|Edron Flats}, the apartments just **south** of Edron castle, and look for the {item:Sewer Grate} in the basement. Enter and follow the sewer until you come out on the surface on the other side, on the peninsula of the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave|Edron Orc Cave}. Bring a {item:Shovel}: to get back to Edron you always have to dig the entrance open.

Go to the **Edron Orc Cave** and enter the orc cult cave. Fight your way through the cult orcs, but **keep at least one {creature:Orc Cult Priest} alive**. Always head **north** until you find a barrier.
To get past the first barrier you have to be transformed into a normal {creature:Orc}.
Sorcerers and Druids can use {spell:Creature Illusion} for the first and the last barrier.
Go down the hole and head **south** to another barrier. Here you have to be transformed into an {creature:Orc Warlord}.
Go down again and head **southeast** to the last barrier. This time you have to be an {creature:Orc Shaman}. Beyond it is the boss lever room.
After passing each barrier in the right form for the first time, you pass automatically on later attempts.
Boss: kill the Security Golems and the machine

After you pull the lever, the team is teleported to a room with 4 {creature:Security Golem|Security Golems}, a {creature:Containment Machine} and {creature:The Armored Voidborn}. For now the boss is protected by the energy wall between the {item:Large Crystal (Blue)|blue crystals}. Kill the 4 Security Golems and then destroy the Containment Machine: the barriers disappear and the crystals become {creature:Containment Crystal|Containment Crystals}.

**Don't attack the Armored Voidborn directly**: it is strong against all damage types. Attack the {creature:Containment Crystal|Containment Crystals}: they cast an area spell that hurts the boss. {creature:Voidshard|Voidshards} keep appearing in the room: kill them so they don't pile up. If you destroy a crystal, move on to the next one.
**Don't let the crystals die!** If all 4 are destroyed, you can no longer finish the boss. The crystals reflect damage: mages should keep an eye on their health.
The crystals can be healed by players: a Druid with {spell:Mass Healing} near the crystal under attack helps a lot. It's also doable without a Druid, because they regenerate slowly.

When the Armored Voidborn dies, it turns into {creature:The Unarmored Voidborn}. This one is weak against all damage types (you'll see hits above 2000), but it has lots of health and takes a while to kill.

After the boss, leave the room and go back the same way: return through the barriers (you pass automatically) and climb up the holes you came down (use the {item:Rope}) to the surface of the peninsula. Go to the sewer entrance and **dig it open with the {item:Shovel}** to get back to the Edron Flats basement. At Edron's port you can take a boat to other cities.
Go back to Feyrist and talk to {npc:Gerimor}: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Orcs}. To get there, use a shrine (step “Reach Feyrist”).

Go to the last floor of the **Dark Pyramid** and go down the hole. Walk **north** and then **west** to {npc:Angelo}. The Dark Pyramid is **northeast** of Darashia: enter and keep going down to the last floor (full of minotaurs).
Hole at the bottom of the Dark Pyramid
The Dark Pyramid, northeast of Darashia
Agree to look for the workers
Say {key:hi}, {key:results}, {key:worried} and {key:yes}. Angelo opens the door for you to look for the missing workers.
Explore the Sandy Cave up to the Oasis

Follow the cave always **southeast** and use the rope to go up a floor. Head **north** and go up again. Then head **east** to a teleport. Enter it and walk **east** to the Oasis: the Quest Log is updated. Leave the Oasis through the teleport **south** of it.

You'll find a {creature:Giant Spider}, several {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts} and {creature:Putrid Mummy|Putrid Mummies}. The Putrid Mummies are much stronger than a normal Mummy, but they're slow and easy to run away from.
Go back to {npc:Angelo} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He gives you a {item:Tool for Analyzing Fluids}.
Go back to the Oasis and use the tool on the water on the **west** side of the Oasis to collect a sample.
Go back to {npc:Angelo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He analyses the water and gives you a tube of {item:Pink Fluid} (counter-agent).

Go to the Oasis again and use the {item:Pink Fluid} on the same spot where you collected the sample. The water turns green and dirty (you are actually teleported to an identical room, north of the clean Oasis). Here is the boss room lever; you can come back later with the team.

{creature:The Sandking} appears in the centre of the room. Attack it with everything you have until it disappears. {creature:Sand Vortex|Sand Vortexes} and {creature:Sand Brood|Sand Broods} then appear: kill a certain number of Sand Broods for the Sandking to return. Repeat until it gets down to about 50% health.

**Don't attack the Sand Vortexes**: they are immortal and reflect all damage, which can be fatal with area spells. If the Sandking steps on {creature:Sand Brood} or {creature:Enraged Sand Brood} corpses, it heals 7500 health: push the corpses against the walls or destroy them with {item:Disintegrate Rune|Disintegrate Runes}.

In phase 2 the Sandking splits into **three**, but they share the same health, so you can attack any of them. {creature:Enraged Sand Brood|Enraged Sand Broods} start to appear: don't forget the corpses. Once you kill them you move on to phase 3, in which the Sandking is much weaker and slower. Attack until it dies.
After the boss, go back the same way: leave the Oasis area through the teleport **south** of it, cross the Sandy Cave back to {npc:Angelo} and climb the Dark Pyramid up to the surface.
Hand in to Angelo and Gerimor
Say {key:hi} to {npc:Angelo} (he's furious with you for killing the creature). Then go to {npc:Gerimor}: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Life}. To get to Feyrist, use a shrine (step “Reach Feyrist”).

Go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, **north** of Thais. Go down **two floors** and head as far **north** as you can; go down one more floor to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}. Head **east** and then **south** and go down the ladder. On the next floor there are lots of {item:Poison Field|poison fields}: run through them and cure the poison, or clear a path with {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field}. Go down another floor, head **east** and **north** (watch out for the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}) and go down the hole marked on the map: below there are 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}.
Route to Mintwallin: Rotworm floor to the ladder
Route to Mintwallin: poison fields floor

After killing the Cyclopes, follow the maps (there are hardly any monsters left); on the last one follow the **blue** line, from A to B. When you reach the two ladders, go down either one and take a few steps **west**: you are at the gate of {wiki:Mintwallin}.
Route to Mintwallin (8): blue line from A to B
Route to Mintwallin (9): the two ladders next to the gate
Go to the entrance of **Mintwallin** and follow the path **east** to a teleport. Enter it and walk **east** again to {npc:Jamesfrancis}.

Ask Jamesfrancis for a {key:mission}. Go through the door and kill **50** cult minotaurs: {creature:Minotaur Cult Follower}, {creature:Minotaur Cult Prophet} and {creature:Minotaur Cult Zealot}. Then go back to Jamesfrancis to report.
These minotaurs are much stronger than the normal ones.
You now have access to {creature:The False God}. Go back to the minotaur area: the teleport is on floor -2. After that teleport, enter the **west** teleport (lever room).
The **east** teleport takes you back to Jamesfrancis and you have to cross the cult minotaurs again.

Up to 5 players. After pulling the lever, go to the **northwest** corner of the room. The statues come to life as {creature:Minotaur Idol|Minotaur Idols}, in order: west to east on the north side, then east to west on the south side. They are strong: kill them first, otherwise they pile up. Only then attack the boss.

When you damage the boss, {creature:Sphere of Wrath|Spheres of Wrath} appear (4 in total, linked to the boss's health). They hit very hard and are indestructible. With more than one, the team should run around the room: they are slow and only have a Berserk-type attack.

Go back through the teleport to Mintwallin, leave through the gate and follow the route in reverse to the {wiki:Ancient Temple} (go up with the {item:Rope} wherever needed). On the way back you can use a shortcut: follow the **red** line to a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and then the **blue** line to the exit. From the Ancient Temple you return to Thais through the north door.
The shortcut is one-way only: the hole marked with the red circle drops you down, but there is nowhere to use the Rope, so it can't take you back to Mintwallin.
Go to Feyrist (step “Reach Feyrist”) and talk to {npc:Gerimor}: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Minotaurs}.
If you don't have the {item:Key 3520} yet, pick it up from a chest near Carlin.
Open the passage in the graveyard

Go to the **Carlin Graveyard** and use the {item:Fragile Torch Bearer} **southwest** of the stairs, next to the {item:Coal Basin}. You hear *“You hear a loud grinding sound not very far from you. Something very heavy seems to have moved.”* The {wiki:Carlin Graveyard} is **east** of Carlin; go down the stairs to the cave.

Head **southwest**, pass the {item:Wooden Coffin|Wooden Coffins} and open the doors with the {item:Key 3520} if needed. Right after the second door, enter the narrow corridor to the **south** and follow it to a {item:Gate of Deathstruction}, which leads to the Forbidden Temple.
As soon as you step through the portal you have more than 10 creatures on top of you. If you are not a Knight, start moving right away so you don't get surrounded.

Kill {creature:Cult Believer|Cult Believers}, {creature:Cult Enforcer|Cult Enforcers} and {creature:Cult Scholar|Cult Scholars} to make souls appear. Step on them within **20 seconds** to collect them. You need **10** {item:Remains of a Decaying Soul} (green) to get past the energy barrier before the stairs to the second floor, and **10** {item:Remains of a Withering Soul} (blue) to reach the third floor.
With access to the third floor, go to the other {item:Gate of Deathstruction} to enter the boss lever room.
Gate of Deathstruction to the boss
When you leave the temple, the stone wall blocks the exit: open it from the inside using the {item:Fragile Torch Bearer} next to the wall.

In the room there are 5 pillars at the corners of a pentagon, each protecting a mini-boss. A mini-boss can only be attacked when its pillar is at 0 health (the pillars don't die, they become {creature:Destroyed Pillar}). Stay close to the walls, where only one or two pillars can hit you, and avoid the centre. You can do them in any order, but start with the {creature:Pillar of Summoning}.

{creature:Malkhar Deathbringer} can take up to 800 health per turn with death damage across the whole room: use maximum protection against Death. The mini-bosses can be healed by players, so Druids should avoid {spell:Mass Healing}.
The pillars' health drops quickly at the start and much more slowly once it reaches red.

After the 5 mini-bosses the {creature:Essence of Malice} appears. It is immune to death damage and about 30% weak to Earth. Mages should use {item:Ultimate Healing Rune|Ultimate Healing Runes}, which deal a lot of damage to it.

After the boss, leave the room and go back the same way to the temple exit. The stone wall will be blocking the way: open it from the inside using the {item:Fragile Torch Bearer} next to the wall. Then go back through the graveyard cave and climb the stairs up to the surface, east of Carlin.
Go back to {npc:Gerimor}: {key:hi}, {key:missions}, {key:Humans}. To get there, use a shrine (step “Reach Feyrist”).
9. The Source of Corruption (final mission, Feyrist)
Only available after you have defeated all the cult bosses and handed them in to Gerimor. Team of up to 10 players, every 20 hours.

Enter the building next to {npc:Gerimor} and then the teleport. Head **south** and enter another teleport: you are in the lever room. When you are done, go back to Gerimor's village and, to return to the mainland, use a Feyrist shrine (step “Leave Feyrist”).

In the room there are {creature:The Remorseless Corruptor} and {creature:Zarcorix of Yalahar}, both invulnerable, as well as {creature:Stolen Soul|Stolen Souls} and {creature:Soul Reaper|Soul Reapers}. An Elite Knight should pull Zarcorix away from the team.
**Don't attack Zarcorix of Yalahar**: it returns all damage 3 times stronger. Avoid area spells and runes.

On each side of the room there are stairs up to a small upper floor with 2 {creature:Dark Soul|Dark Souls}. Put 1 or 2 players on each side to kill the Dark Souls: when they die they turn into {item:Guilt (Item)|Guilt}. Whoever is upstairs throws the Guilt down, and whoever is downstairs uses it on {creature:The Remorseless Corruptor} (*“You have raised the guilt of the corruptor”*).
If the Dark Souls are not killed quickly, they disappear and Soul Reapers appear downstairs. It is best to have fixed players upstairs.
Phase 1: kill The Corruptor of Souls

With enough Guilt, the boss turns into {creature:The Corruptor of Souls}, which is vulnerable. Keep using Guilt on it (otherwise it becomes invulnerable again) and kill it. Zarcorix disappears and {creature:The Source of Corruption} appears.

Try to trap the boss in a corner (summoned {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} help) and attack until it dies. It always summons 2 {creature:Soul Reaper|Soul Reapers}: ignore them and focus on the boss.

Go back to {npc:Gerimor} and say {key:hi}, {key:missions}. You need **2 free slots**. Answer {key:yes} to receive the crown for your vocation, the {item:Mystery Box} and the achievement **Corruption Contained**.

50,000 experience, {item:Leaf Crown} / {item:Reflecting Crown} / {item:Iron Crown} / {item:Incandescent Crown} / {item:Sensing Crown} (depending on your vocation), {item:Mystery Box} and the Corruption Contained achievement
Experience per cult: Barkless 50,000, Misguided 50,000, Prosperity 50,000, Orcs 25,000, Life 50,000, Minotaurs 25,000, Humans 25,000; final mission 50,000.
Once you have gained access to a cult boss, you can repeat it every 20 hours by going straight into the lever room.
